scope: 已保存的 219 表结构、同版本源码及本地旧快照计数；不访问生产，不读取客户业务行。
conclusion: 219 是业务实体、明细、历史、审计、缓存、配置及旧版表的合计，不能仅凭总数判断过度设计。建议先退旧流程、统一目录/口径/运行机制，再依据收益决定物理合表。

priority_groups.title: 日期备份表移出运行库
priority_groups.reason: 属于历史修复时保留的副本，不必长期混在正常业务模型里。
priority_groups.boundary: 保留完整原始内容、结构和恢复说明；先确认不是唯一回退依据及外部脚本依赖，不直接 DROP。

priority_groups.title: 旧版上架流程退役
priority_groups.reason: 现行上架读写集中在 listing_publish_tasks/items、listing_shop_copies、listing_publish_records；旧四表未在本次 src 静态扫描找到活跃消费者。
priority_groups.boundary: 三个旧表在保存快照中为空，但 generated_images 有 3 条记录。须核查外部工具、旧版本和恢复用途；既有图片文件不随表归档删除。

priority_groups.title: 统一车型目录
priority_groups.action: 先映射迁移，再合并职责
priority_groups.reason: 两套目录都有实际消费者，容易造成不同页面车型不一致。适合统一一个公共＋企业补充目录服务。
priority_groups.boundary: 保留旧 ID、别名、俄文名称和年份等信息；先切换所有读取和初始化路径。历史定义不被最新公共项自动覆盖。

priority_groups.title: 统一库存余额口径
priority_groups.action: 先收口计算与读取，不直接合数值
priority_groups.reason: 存在两套余额投影和维护路径，但新投影还纳入需求、未交运扣减加回和 FBP 占用，二者不是同义副本。
priority_groups.boundary: 确认实物、可用、预留、在途等定义，逐消费者比对后再评估旧投影退役；inventory_movements 原始流水保留。

priority_groups.title: 统一 AI 与发布任务的运行机制
priority_groups.action: 统一运行基础设施，业务明细分开
priority_groups.reason: 可复用企业/人员上下文、状态、进度、重试、撤权和恢复机制，减少各套 worker 自己实现一遍。
priority_groups.boundary: 不是把所有业务压进一张 JSON 表。生成、保存草稿、发布回执、额度事件仍保留各自生命周期与幂等规则。

priority_groups.title: 统一缓存、日志与大 JSON 的生命周期
priority_groups.action: 先控制体积与刷新成本
priority_groups.reason: 适合统一企业缓存键、TTL、失效、增量刷新和冷热保留。它通常比单纯减少表数更有助于性能与容量。
priority_groups.boundary: 统计日表的粒度不同，不能随意合并；历史原文有回退用途。未完成或回执未知任务、人工编辑、历史成本不能当普通缓存清理。

priority_groups.title: 统一配置归属和接口
priority_groups.action: 统一 scope 与访问边界，暂不强求物理合表
priority_groups.reason: 当前平台、企业、个人、店铺配置存在多套入口与键语义。统一归属规则比合成一个大键值表更重要。
priority_groups.boundary: 审计记录与当前配置分开；不把所有 settings 变为平台共享。旧 tenant_activation_codes 仍有接口和写入，不能作为死表删除。

candidate_reviews.action: migrate_and_consolidate_dictionary
candidate_reviews.reason: Two vehicle dictionaries are actually consumed by current code. The asset-engine bootstrap seeds/lists asset_vehicle_models, while AI uses ai_vehicle_catalog with public builtin plus enterprise-private rows. A single catalog service and explicit legacy-to-canonical mapping would remove competing model lists and repeated normalization.

Active vehicle models are read from asset_vehicle_models.

Current quick-fission case UI reads the AI vehicle catalog endpoint.

Map each legacy ID to a reviewed canonical ID; keep original labels and provenance.
Keep builtin dictionaries separate from enterprise supplements and prevent private rows leaking through bootstrap.
Switch every active reader/seed path to the common service before retiring the old writer/table.

candidate_reviews.action: unify_task_orchestration_first_then_optional_header_consolidation
candidate_reviews.reason: Several task engines duplicate claiming, retries, progress, creator attribution and recovery. Standardize one tenant-aware task envelope/runner and typed handlers before considering whether selected job-header tables can merge. The external-publishing receipt state machine must remain distinct. A giant shared JSON table would reduce names while weakening validation.

evidence.reason: Generic generator owns queue scheduling/worker limits.
Generic task recovery restores the saved tenant and actor.

Verify retry/restart/revocation/expired-subscription behavior for every handler.
Drain or explicitly transfer active tasks; retain business-specific child/result structures where their semantics differ.
Keep listing_publish_records and per-shop publish items durable even if a shared runner orchestrates them.

candidate_reviews.action: consolidate_case_representations_after_semantic_mapping
candidate_reviews.reason: Reusable generation recipes, template-attached examples and user-visible successful fission cases currently have overlapping representation layers. Preserve a recipe/template concept and a successful-example concept, then map older template examples into the chosen case model if all provenance is representable. ai_variant_case_runs appears schema-only in this focused runtime scan and is separately an archive/inventory candidate.

candidate_reviews.reason: The same image can have a reusable material-library entry, a physical/publication asset record, generated shop-level variant output and field-level AI result attribution. A common asset directory/provenance service can stop repeated URL/file metadata and inconsistent image selection. Business material metadata and technical publishing readiness have different responsibilities, so preserve their distinction even if later storage is normalized.
